faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: FSRS is a spaced-repetition algorithm that decides when you should review each puzzle to maximize long-term learning.
faq.a2: Your ELO goes up when you solve puzzles harder than your level and down when you fail puzzles at your range.
faq.a3: Premium removes ads, syncs your progress to the cloud, and gives unlimited access to FSRS reviews.
faq.q4: Can I use the app offline?
faq.a4: Yes. The app caches up to 50 puzzles and syncs your progress when you reconnect.
faq.q5: How does the referral system work?
faq.a5: Share your unique link. When your friend completes 5 puzzles, you both get 7 free days of Premium.
faq.q6: How do I cancel my subscription?
faq.a6: On iOS: Settings → your name → Subscriptions. On Android: Play Store → Subscriptions. On web: via the Stripe portal.
faq.q7: Will I lose my progress if I uninstall the app?
faq.a7: If you have an account, your progress is in the cloud and can always be recovered. As a guest, data is stored only on the device.
